reason: I'd rather wire an LLM API to my own content myself than pay another monthly sub. I might try the free plan if I had traffic worth testing, but I wouldn't start paying in the first month.
objection: Another monthly subscription for something visitors might ignore. My traffic is small, so I can't tell if a mascot would lift anything, and I can build a basic version myself in a weekend.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the free tier's A/B report show a real lift on my own site, or a case study from a site of my size with numbers.
